description: CompressionMHL FFN, grid cell G9 — iso-C and iso-param with exp_n_0118 but traded the other way (deeper tables, fewer of them). H=4 heads, compress 384->48, LUT, decompress 48->384, nap=10 (2^10=1024 cells/table), tph=128 tables/head, C=tph*2^nap=131072, independent per-head compression, untied unembedder, 16k steps, device_batch 12 x grad_accum 4 (effective 24,576). 180,597,900 params (FFN 151.9M, 21.45x vanilla) — bit-identical param count to exp_n_0118. Re-scored under the FIXED validation protocol (see ../../FIXED_EVAL.md): batch size 48 x 100 eval steps, leading 12 rows skipped, batch-size-INDEPENDENT, on the held-out val shard (shard_06542.parquet) from token 0. Rebuilt from config.json (ffn_type=compression) and loaded from checkpoint.pt with 0 missing / 0 unexpected keys.
interpretation: Under the corrected protocol exp_n_0133 sits +0.00391 bpb ABOVE the matched vanilla baseline; the grid summary reported it -0.02183 BELOW. Sign flips, same cause as the rest of the grid (batch-coupled eval at device_batch_size 12). The iso-param comparison with exp_n_0118 SURVIVES correction and keeps its direction: at identical 180,597,900 params and identical C=131072, wide-and-shallow (nap9/tph256, 1.16494) beats deep-and-narrow (nap10/tph128, 1.16906) by 0.00412 corrected, against 0.00501 as originally reported. It beats the naive LUT by 0.0239 bpb at 55% of its parameters.
